title: Cambridge IELTS 16 Test 1 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
prompt: In some countries, more and more people are becoming interested in finding out about the history of the house or building they live in.
scenario: In some countries, more and more people are becoming interested in finding out about the history of the house or building they live in.
requirements: What are the reasons for this?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
